Due to an accident at the venue, the competition was moved from March 16th to April 27th.

Devido a um acidente no local do campeonato, o evento foi adiado do dia 16 de março para o dia 27 de abril.

items.name: French Championship 2013
items.information: The comptetition is open to competitors of all nationalities. However, only French cubers can win prizes and honours. The entrance is free and people can sleep at the venue. 150 competitiors max.

items.information: Winona, MN welcomes its first competition and is open to everyone.rnRegistration Fee is $5 first event and $2 for each additional event.  [Winona Open 2013 registration page](http://www.cubingusa.com/winona/register.php)

items.name: Diamond Bar Spring Open 2013
items.information: The registration fee is $15 flat fee per competitor, with $1 going to the WCA. If you register at the door, the fee doubles to $30 and you will NOT be able to compete in BLD, MBLD, and/or FMC.  See website for more details.

items.name: Berkeley Spring 2013
items.information: $3*n+1, where n is the number of events you are competing in. $1 from each competitor's complete registration is collected as the WCA fee, and goes towards maintenance of WCA servers and other miscellaneous expenses.
